name: Waterfall
desc: Noise you have to shout over - the place for a scene that cannot be overheard.
tags: scenery, no humans, waterfall, white water falling, plunge pool, mist and spray, wet black rock, moss on rocks, rainbow in spray, boulders at base, ferns on cliff face
prose: a waterfall dropping down a wet black rock face into a churning plunge pool, spray hanging in the air with a faint rainbow through it, mossy boulders at the base and ferns clinging to the cliff
note: Scale collapses: a two hundred foot fall and a garden cascade render identically unless something at the base gives a measure, so keep the boulders or put a figure on the rocks. Spray and wet rock are what make it read loud and wet - without them it is a still blue ribbon painted on a cliff. The word cascade tends to produce stacked tiers, so say a single drop if that is what you want.
